verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online service that stores customer documents and offers AI-powered features (e.g., AI-generated meeting minutes), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The pack has no documented control or policy that keeps user data out of AI model training. The llms.txt probe only gives guidance to AI crawlers about the public site, and the registered-agent address privacy is an unrelated feature; neither counts toward this story.
